outcome: Postnatal resection pathology (mature, immature, malignant SCTs)
cohort: Fourteen patients with fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) managed at a single academic tertiary center between 2006 and 2023.
finding: Fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) is associated with significant morbidity for both the pregnant patient and the neonate.
followup_time: Outcomes were evaluated over an 18-year period (2006-2023), including long-term postnatal survival and complications.
